channel.description: AI phone agents for local businesses and agencies

item.title: Speed to lead: why calling back in under a minute changes conversion
item.description: Speed to lead is how fast you reach a new lead. The research on 5-minute versus 30-minute callbacks, what it does not prove, and how to get under a minute.

item.title: How to measure whether your AI receptionist is working
item.description: Five numbers tell you if your AI receptionist works: answered calls, outcomes logged, hand-offs, bookings and wrong answers. Where to find each one.

item.title: AI phone agents for HVAC: handling the first heat wave or cold snap
item.description: What an AI phone agent can and can't do for an HVAC shop when the first heat wave or cold snap hits: answer every call, triage, and promise honest windows.

item.title: What to put in an AI receptionist's script (with examples)
item.description: Six parts every AI receptionist script needs, with example lines for a plumbing business, plus what to leave out and how to test it before real calls.

item.title: Can an AI receptionist work with my existing business number?
item.description: Yes. Forward calls from your current number, or move the number itself. How each route works, what can break, and which one to pick.

item.title: How an AI phone agent handles emergency calls safely
item.description: How an AI phone agent should handle emergency calls: tell the caller to leave, transfer to a person, never improvise. Tested numbers and when not to use one.

item.title: AI receptionist for real estate agents: qualifying buyers at 9pm
item.description: What an AI receptionist can do for a real estate agent at 9pm: ask the qualifying questions and book the viewing. And what it should never say.

item.title: After-hours calls: what home-service businesses lose overnight
item.description: About 10% to 14% of HVAC calls arrive off-hours. How to price what you lose overnight from your own call log, and when an AI agent is not worth it.

item.title: How long does it take to set up an AI phone agent?
item.description: A demo number you can call takes about 48 hours. Going live on your real line takes longer, because your number and your approval set the pace.

item.title: How restaurants can take phone orders with AI during the Friday rush
item.description: An AI phone agent can take pickup orders while your staff cook, because it answers many calls at once. Here is what it handles, what it can't, and the cost.

item.title: AI receptionist for dental practices: what it should and shouldn't handle
item.description: An AI receptionist for a dental practice should book, reschedule and answer set questions. Clinical advice and insurance quotes must go to your team.

item.title: What happens when an AI receptionist doesn't know the answer?
item.description: A well-built AI receptionist says it doesn't know, takes a message and logs the call. How to test that, and what a bad one does instead.

item.title: Self storage after hours calls: what a facility loses when nobody answers
item.description: Self storage after hours calls go to voicemail, and most callers hang up. How to count what that costs your facility, and when an AI agent is not worth it.

item.title: Klaviyo abandoned cart flow filter: stop emailing people who already paid
item.description: Why a Klaviyo abandoned cart flow emails customers who already paid, the one flow filter that stops it, and how to test it with a real checkout.

item.title: How to hire a Vapi or Retell developer: what to check before you pay
item.description: How to hire a Vapi developer or Retell builder: seven checks on accounts, webhooks, testing and cost, plus when a template is enough and you can skip them.

item.title: White-label AI voice agent for GoHighLevel: how the reselling works
item.description: How a GoHighLevel agency resells a white-label AI voice agent: what you pay per account, what you charge, where the margin goes and when not to bother.

item.title: AI receptionist for self storage: reservations, payments and gate codes
item.description: An AI receptionist for self storage can quote units, reserve them and reset gate codes after hours. What to automate, what to keep human, and the risks.

item.title: Voice agent prompt injection testing: a phone-call runbook
item.description: A practical runbook for voice agent prompt injection testing: which attacks to try, what to check in code, and the fix that took leaks from 14 calls to 0.

item.title: Can an AI phone agent book appointments into GoHighLevel?
item.description: Yes. Compare GoHighLevel's Voice AI, Vapi's built-in tools and custom API calls for booking during a call, plus where each one breaks.

item.title: How to build a missed-call AI callback with GoHighLevel and Retell
item.description: How you would build a missed-call AI callback: a GoHighLevel workflow, a text, a Retell call. What our demo covers and which steps it did not run.
